parameters.help_en: The name of the source database instance
parameters.name: source_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the new primary instance after the migration is complete
parameters.help_zh: 迁移完成后的新主实例名称
parameters.name: new_master_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically swap connection strings. Valid values:

true: The application does not need to modify configurations. Connections are automatically directed to the new instance.

false: You must manually update the application endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动交换连接字符串：

true：应用无需修改配置，连接自动指向新实例；

false：需手动更新应用连接地址
parameters.name: swap_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The specific endpoints to switch. The value is a JSON string that corresponds to the endpoint pairs to be swapped.
This parameter takes effect only when SwapConnectionString is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
需要切换的具体连接地址。取值为需要两两交换的地址对应的JSON串。
当SwapConnectionString取值为true时生效
parameters.name: connection_strings
